text:
maria: Heads-up — Raj (new hire, SWE) starts Mon at the Tokyo satellite office. Passport expires Apr 15 (~28 days). Need to confirm I-9 intake + same-day badge handoff. What are our practical options? :thinking:

jordan: For I-9 — as long as the passport is unexpired on the date of completion it should be OK. The wrinkle is cross-border: Raj is remote in JP but we're onboarding under the US entity. We can use a company-approved mobile notary or an authorized agent at the satellite hub.

maria: Good. Can facilities handle a badge ready-to-pickup flow if the notary completes the I-9 in the morning? We want Raj to be productive by 11am if possible.

sam: We can do a same-day handoff at the satellite front desk, yes. Need: scan of the passport, signed visitor/badge form, and security approval. If mobile notary confirms completion before 10:30, badge can be issued at 11.

sam: Quick checklist I need from people-ops to clear security (paste this to Raj also):

```
- passport scan (color, photo page)
- copy of mobile notary attestation (PDF)
- signed badge policy form (e-sign OK)
- local contact at satellite (sam@redwood)
- expected pickup window (e.g., 11:00-12:00 JST)
```

maria: I'll schedule the mobile notary for Mon 08:30 JST (gives buffer). Also sending Raj the e-sign badge policy now.

courier-bot: Concierge note — "Badge pickup code 4821" will be generated when badge is provisioned. Please confirm pickup window in the note to the concierge.

raj: Thanks — I can do the notary slot. Passport scan incoming in 5 min. Quick Q: if the passport expires soon after day 1, any additional steps?

jordan: Notarized I-9 completion only requires documents to be unexpired at the time of verification. However, for relocation/work authorization we should check visa expiry separately. People-ops will flag if we need follow-up.

maria: Confirmed. Raj — please upload the passport scan and e-signed badge policy here and I'll confirm with sam. I'll also add a Day-1 orientation blurb: 09:30 JST people-ops intro (Zoom link), 10:30 team sync, 11:00 badge pickup.

sam: :thumbsup: I will reserve the desk and notify security.

courier-bot: Security clearance request submitted (ticket #SEC-2026-118). ETA for approval ~45 min.

maria: Perfect, thanks all. Looping in @raj to finish uploads — once the notary PDF is in, I'll mark thread resolved and post final pickup code.

raj: Uploaded passport + signed form. Thanks, everyone!

maria: Received and forwarded to security. Will update here when the badge code is live. :party_popper:
